title: Spikefinder five-preparation calcium inference
retrieval_date_semantics: accessed_on is this fresh retrieval, not publication date or proof of exhaustive indexing; null publication_date means not verified
search_queries: spikefinder benchmark2025 calcium deconvolution supervised CASCADE ENS2

candidates.name: CASCADE / CascadeTorch
candidates.evidence: Established supervised family with active 2026 support. Port preserves predictions; blind use of global checkpoints may include evaluation neurons.
candidates.role: contender; not evaluated on our frozen slice

candidates.name: ENS2
candidates.evidence: Supervised compact U-Net; paper claims accuracy/efficiency advantages under its protocols. Refit or provenance-audit checkpoints.
candidates.role: contender; not evaluated on our frozen slice

candidates.name: SpikeSSL
candidates.evidence: October 2026 preprint contender, bidirectional dynamics layers and simulation augmentation. DS04 appears in published OGB evaluation set, but not our exact fish split.
candidates.role: contender; not evaluated on our frozen slice

candidates.name: C-SPIKES BiophysSMC / BiophysML
candidates.evidence: Mechanistic-kinetics Bayesian/synthetic-training family. Current characterized indicators include GCaMP6f/7f/8f; OGB applicability not established.
candidates.role: contender; not evaluated on our frozen slice

candidates.name: OASIS / MLspike / PGBAR
candidates.evidence: Important model-based/calibration and posterior references; performance depends on indicator, temporal resolution and tuning.
candidates.role: contender; not evaluated on our frozen slice

candidates.name: slugFind model-predictive-control
candidates.evidence: Recent direct Spikefinder contender; resource/runtime and matched preprocessing require reproduction.
candidates.role: contender; not evaluated on our frozen slice

current_best_claim_scope: Exact executed custom input/split/metric protocol, not best within our small inspected local set
current_reference: Archived 2017 Deneux/Speiser/Friedrich/Rupprecht predictions plus local OASIS
current_reference_limitations: Historical archive scores establish historical comparators, not 2026 best.
Some CASCADE/ENS2/SpikeSSL training corpora overlap Spikefinder-source recordings; generic public weights can leak labels.
Different smoothing, trial handling, dataset grouping and test-time parameter fits can change rank.
The five preparations are one endpoint, not five independent task discoveries.
recommended_next_comparator: Freeze a modern same-source rerun: CASCADE and ENS2 retrained excluding each evaluated preparation, SpikeSSL with explicit train/evaluation source audit, and train-tuned OASIS/MLspike. Preserve official 40 ms binning, per-cell correlations and equal-preparation aggregation; report error/bias and all training resources separately.
switching_assessment: NO GENERAL REPLACEMENT RECOMMENDATION. Current evidence supports a bounded code-synthesis/pilot comparison to the named local reference. Establish prospective same-input/split/metric contender runs, biological/source replication, calibration and runtime/reliability before switching production tools.
limitations: Historical archive scores establish historical comparators, not 2026 best.
Some CASCADE/ENS2/SpikeSSL training corpora overlap Spikefinder-source recordings; generic public weights can leak labels.
Different smoothing, trial handling, dataset grouping and test-time parameter fits can change rank.
The five preparations are one endpoint, not five independent task discoveries.
negative_findings: No active official 2026 Spikefinder leaderboard with these current models and our exact protocol verified.
New GCaMP8 and synthetic-kinetics victories cannot establish OGB/GCaMP6 or whole-challenge superiority.
